Coverage_Description: Covers employer liability and domestic-helper related risks, including employees' compensation, outpatient/hospitalisation/surgery, dental, repatriation, personal liability, and op
pricing: Per helper premium examples: Basic HK$120 (1 month), HK$280 (3 months), HK$300 (1 year), HK$550 (2 years); Comprehensive HK$730 (1 year), HK$1,320 (2 years)
customer requirement: Applicant must be the insured domestic helper's employer (overseas helper must match employment contract); application must be signed by applicant aged 18+
price structure: Premium is charged per domestic helper, by selected plan (Basic/Comprehensive/Comprehensive+Top-Up/Top-Up only) and insurance term (1 month,
additional informations: 15-day waiting period for most medical benefits and 12-month waiting period for maternity benefit; driving duty may require underwriting with 25% extra premium; minimum premium HK$300 on policy adjustment/termination
